about: Who owns what in the forest village example (see forest-village-place-settings.json). Five owners build at the same time; the ground is built first and frozen. A stage may change only what its owner owns (collection "Place: <owner>", names, materials); the camera, lights, world and render settings are frozen. `explainer-film-place ownership-diff` and `combine` check this.

contracts.rule: cottages sit on the frozen ground height (seat_on_ground); roads_and_ground never moves a cottage
nothing from forest_edge stands on a lane, a wheel track or a keep-clear shape
